```python
class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self, tokens, refill_rate):
            self.tokens = tokens
            self.refill_rate = refill_rate
    def take(self, n=1):
        self._refill()
        if self.tokens < n:
            return False
        self.tokens -= n
        return True
```
The token bucket handles bursts up to the initial token count.
